answers.core: It's a core feature of how `Resource`s work in Godot.
answers.workaround: I think this might be possible.  You'd have to get every single property of the existing resource at that path and copy them over to the new resource.  Then you'd have to attach the `changed` signal of the existing resource and redo the copy.  Not pretty and I don't think it would give proper results in all situations.

title: Add in-place loading of Resources on existing instances
